verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same exponent addition and the same two inclusions, with two encoding points. (i) Both Lean lemmas carry the hypothesis hζ : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1, which `StripData` does not impose (it only requires ζ smooth and ≥ 0); for the paper's ζ of (6.23), ζ = exp(−a_a/log²(X/X_a) − a_b/log²(X_b/X)) ≤ 1, so the hypothesis is automatic and the statements agree — this is the same ζ² ≤ ζ used in the paper's own proof on p. 72. (ii) Lean's M_α and W_α (`MeanClass`, `WaveClass`) are `MemClass` with weights ζ and √ζ·P, i.e. only the all-order derivative bounds of (6.24)/(6.29); the structural clauses of Definitions 6.4–6.5 (∂_θ f = 0, descent to the common torus, supp ⊂ Ω_γ, smooth zero extension) are carried by separate Lean predicates (e.g. `AngularIndependent`, `SupportedOscillations`) and are therefore not re-established by these inclusions. The Lean products are taken through an arbitrary continuous bilinear map, which covers the paper's scalar product.
